name: ac-equity-research
description: Fundamental research on a listed company before capital is committed: primary filings and sources, the three financial statements and how they link, ratio analysis with its caveats, evidence for or against a durable competitive advantage, management and capital-allocation record, accounting and business red flags, and the written research record. It analyses evidence and states confidence; it never recommends a stock, predicts a price, or gives investment advice. Use when asking "research this company", "read the 10-K", "is this a good business", "equity research", "what do the accounts say". Not for valuing the company (ac-valuation), not for portfolio policy (ac-investment-policy-statement), not for token diligence (ac-token-diligence).
